Claim 3 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on a minimum desired throughput for each particular node, and wherein the minimum desired throughput is defined as a threshold value that each node aims to achieve in its communications.

Claim 4 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node relative to an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the other nodes that are interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

Claim 14 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast a dynamic weight associated with the second node to the first node, wherein the dynamic weight is based on a transmission success rate of the second node.

Claim 17 (currently amended): (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and the first node interferes with communication between the second node and the second access point, wherein the interference is characterized by a reduction in the transmission success rate between the second node and the second access point.
